$comment: Intentionally-unwired indicator artifacts. Every entry blocks the catalogue-coverage drift detector from failing. Adding a new artifact to datasets/indicators/in/ MUST be paired with EITHER (a) a topic-catalogue.json entry OR (b) an entry here with a reason. Removing an entry here without wiring it is the ratchet that closes the gap (see TODO/VIZ-LAYER-GAPS-PLAN.md Phase 0). The reason field is plain English; tag with the phase it belongs to so the audit trail is legible. As of G5-PR-A (2026-06-08) the allowlist is empty: the 11 silent-orphan rows (8 fiscal + 3 economy, annotated 'rendered via canonical descriptor' / 'phase4-pending' but whose descriptors never landed in frontend/src/lib/canonical/indicator-allowlist.ts) were paired with disk deletion + matching meadow-shard-contract.txt pruning in the same commit. The file shape is preserved so future ingests can still drop justified rows here.
